resolvedQuestions.text: What is the exact claudish-to-english architecture with file-and-line evidence?
Safest integration boundary in each of the six CLIs for display-only projection?
What normalized event and message model preserves canonical state across all six runtimes?
What provider-neutral configuration supports OpenCode Go DeepSeek V4 Flash and local Ollama/llama.cpp with privacy-aware routing?
How should protected spans be encoded and fidelity validated so the system can objectively reject bad rewrites and fall back to the exact original?
Observability and evaluation methods for perceptual 1:1 parity?
Downstream phase decomposition and handoff evidence?
